title: kb-tests-windows exceeds the 1 h job timeout, so its failures are never named
goal: The Windows job finishes within its limit and prints pytest's summary: job 16821688871 (kb-tests-windows on 88f12ea9f, pipeline 2895116171) ran tests.py for the full hour, reached about 91% with 2 failures and 3 errors, and was killed at the project default of 1 h (execution took longer than 1h0m0s) before pytest named any failure or stress_test.py ran; kb-tests-windows sets a timeout that fits tests.py plus stress_test.py (or splits them), and a rerun names or clears the two failures
notes: The job ran pytest with 2 xdist workers: a Hyper-V container gets 2 vCPUs by default. The operator chose 6 CPUs and 12 GB per container for the docker-windows runner (config.toml, outside the repository; runners.md records it) and a longer job timeout; the job is started by hand.
